targetText: It was resolved to present the government with a vote of lack of confidence, and to put the union in the hands of the workers.
explanation: Working-class self-organization and revolutionary industrial action during the pre-1917 Bolshevik trade union struggles.

targetText: Vasya was sitting in the car, her head pillowed on her woolen shawl. She was not sleeping, but she saw the past as in a dream, as in a moving picture: reel after reel, scene after scene, joy and misery, all her life with Vladimir, with Volodya.
explanation: Reflecting on the early romantic passion shared during the heroic days of underground revolutionary struggle.
